title: Inventory Wood Stripper
description: This plugin adds convenient wood trimming using an axe in your inventory.
body:
Did you previously have to manually cut each log individually? This plugin will save you from that chore.

Simply place any supported wood in any crafting slot, add any axe, and quickly create a large amount of refined wood.
**The axe will also take durability damage, so be careful and keep an eye on your axe's durability! Cutting 1 block of wood costs 1 durability of your axe!**
